description:
Winnovative Next RTF to PDF Converter for .NET (Multi-platform) is a component of the Winnovative PDF Next Library for .NET that enables accurate conversion of complex RTF documents to PDF.

The converter targets .NET Standard 2.0 and can be used in .NET Core and .NET Framework applications deployed on Windows and Linux platforms, including Azure App Service, Azure Functions and Docker.

This multi-platform metapackage installs the Windows x64 and Linux x64 runtimes.

For Windows ARM64, Linux ARM64 and macOS ARM64, the additional packages Winnovative.Pdf.Next.RtfToPdf.Windows.Arm64, Winnovative.Pdf.Next.RtfToPdf.Linux.Arm64 and Winnovative.Pdf.Next.RtfToPdf.MacOS can be referenced on their own or alongside this package.

Compatibility:

* Windows 10, 11 and Windows Server 2016 to 2025 (x64)
* Linux (x64) - Debian 11+, Ubuntu 20.04+ or equivalent
* Windows, Linux and macOS (ARM64) - via additional packages
* .NET 10.0, 9.0, 8.0, 7.0, 6.0 and .NET Standard 2.0
* .NET Framework 4.6.2 to 4.8.1
* Azure App Service and Azure Functions
* Virtual Machines
* Docker containers
* Web, Console and Desktop applications

Main Features:

* Convert RTF documents from memory or from a file to PDF
* Convert RTF content from .NET strings to PDF
* Use custom PDF page settings to automatically reflow the content
* Automatically create a table of contents based on headings in RTF
* Add HTML headers, footers or stamps to the generated PDF
* Control the PDF document display with PDF viewer preferences
* Encrypt, set permissions and set passwords for the generated PDF documents
* Add digital signatures to the generated PDF document
* Asynchronous methods for async and await

Documentation and code samples:
https://www.winnovative-software.com/winnovative-pdf-next-rtf-to-pdf-dotnet
